results.text: Understanding The Number Needed to Treat. The number needed to treat (NNT) is the inverse of the absolute risk difference, which is used as a secondary outcome to clinical trials as a measure relevant to a positive trial, supplementing statistical significance. results.text: A bibliometric and visualisation study of nifedipine in the treatment of coronary heart disease.

Daily Versus BID Nifedipine GITS in Severe Preeclampsia: Randomized Controlled Trial. Optimal dosing of nifedipine gastrointestinal therapeutic system (GITS) in pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia with severe features is unknown. We assessed whether nifedipine GITS 30 mg BID improved blood pressure control when compared with nifedipine GITS 60 mg daily.
